title: CIA and ODNI open-source intelligence system breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the CIA, ODNI, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A breach reported at US intelligence agencies, a matter for the national government. The known impact is one unclassified analysis system; sources say no classified systems were affected, and what was exposed is not known.
who_is_affected: Analysts at the CIA, ODNI and, reportedly, the NGA who use the system. The public does not use it, and nobody outside the agencies has been told to do anything.

known.text: Four news outlets, each with its own sources, report that hackers breached an unclassified CIA and ODNI system used for open-source intelligence.
The CIA declined to comment, and neither agency has confirmed the breach on the record.
The New York Times first reported the breach on Nov 24.

not_known.text: What information was exposed, and when the breach happened.
Who did it. No government body has named anyone.
